newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO picks Madrid as next summit site.
newsitem.headline: NATO picks Madrid as next summit site.

text.p: NATO foreign ministers have agreed on Madrid as the venue for a summit on July 8-9 next year to set the course for enlargement of the alliance, a NATO official said.
"It is going to be Madrid," the official told Reuters.
At the summit, NATO intends to invite a number of former communist foes to begin membership talks. Hungary, Poland and the Czech republic are considered the most likely.

Earlier, NATO Secretary General Javier Solana, a former Spanish foreign minister, told the allies the summit would "shape the new NATO -- a NATO with new structures, new missions and ultimately with new members."
